hints.title: Bouncing Index Path Simulation
hints.text: Characters alternate downward and diagonally upward across a fixed number of rows. How can tracking the active row position place each character into its destination bucket?

hints.title: Directional Inversion at Boundaries
hints.text: Maintain an index tracking the active row alongside a step direction variable. When reaching the top row or the bottom row, invert the step sign to bounce between limits.

hints.title: Row Buffer Accumulation Blueprint
hints.text: If numRows is one or exceeds string length, return s directly. Create numRows string buffers. Iterate through s, appending each character to rows[currentRow], and adjust currentRow by step (+1 or -1).

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: length of input string s
complexity.notes: Single pass distributing characters into row buffers followed by join.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Constructing full 2D grid matrices wastes O(N * numRows) memory with mostly empty whitespace cells.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Maintaining only row string accumulators eliminates sparse cell allocations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Correct boundary condition handling when numRows is 1 or greater than or equal to string length.
